subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Scotch Yoke: Perfect Sinusoidal Motion
description: A quick win: understand Scotch Yoke: Perfect Sinusoidal Motion.

hook.text: What if you need output that follows a perfect sine wave? One mechanism does it.

buildup.text: A pin on a rotating disc slides inside a slot on a yoke that moves in a line.

discovery.text: The yoke's position is the exact sine of the crank angle — pure harmonic motion.

twist.text: High slot friction limits speed. The sliding contact wears fast.

climax.text: Vibration test machines and some pumps use the Scotch yoke for smooth output.

punchline.text: A slot and a pin deliver the purest sine wave mechanics can make.

quiz.question: What makes the Scotch yoke unique compared to a slider-crank?
options: It can handle heavier loads than a slider-crank
It produces exactly sinusoidal output motion, not an approximation
It eliminates the need for a connecting rod
